reasons.reader_question: Sharp closing question: will Ila hand over the sheets, or lie? Bible-aware readers also dread the lie and its cost.
reasons.change: Knowledge shifts: hostages taken, no walnut, Mini fled. Relationship shifts: Kunal reverses his creed and asks Ila for everything.
reasons.romance_movement: New reason for strain: his first full ask meets her refusal-in-waiting. Her own non-negotiable is argued tactically, not named.
reasons.shown_chemistry: Responsive acts: she gives him a blood measure to stand on, works the nail wordlessly, reads his hedge; he lets her 'that's what I said' stand.
reasons.character_logic: Grief-driven trade and hedged belief are credible. Mini's lone pony track is raised, then dropped without any decision from a man soft on children.
reasons.stakes_and_cost: The price is explicit: the hills' one door, his creed and her map against one friend, at stated one-in-three odds.
reasons.prose: Concrete and readable, but dense with similes. Self-monitoring beats repeat ('steady, which surprised him', 'proud... ashamed', 'which was the horror'). 'Chain' echoes three times.
reasons.continuity: Consistent: left fingertips pink, right dead, eight pairs, walnut rule, Gauri as sister, Mini's pony, five sheets, twenty-four winters since the lesson.

fixes: At 'He could not see the lake without wondering' the Mini thread is dropped (irrational behaviour). Kunal softens with children, so make him decide on the page. Have him read the track as heading toward Gauri's sister's orchard, or name that the eight spans and the moonrise deadline forbid following. One or two lines, so leaving the child is a choice with a cost.

At 'You don't.' / 'Then tell me.' / 'Not yet.' Ila answers only tactically (the route-keepers die), so the 'two non-negotiables meet head on' beat lands half. Before 'Kunal, what happens to the route-keepers', give her one true line naming her own line. For example: the sheets are the only true record, and she will not hand a true map to the men who drowned its keeper. Let it chill nothing.

At 'It did not feel like a defeat. That was what frightened him', the line duplicates 'without flinching, which was the horror of it' (repetitive interiority). Cut one of them, and cut either 'which surprised him' or 'proud of that, and ashamed of the pride'. Replace one of the three 'chain' images with something else. Change 'he saw the paper' to 'the hide' to match the next line.
reader_question: When Kunal asks where the sheets are, will Ila give up the hills' ways, or lie to him and pay for it?
new_facts_assessment: new-facts.json is empty, yet the draft adds facts: a hand-wide blood stain, the blue wool strip, Mini's pony track, apricots off Gauri's palm, four hundred mornings, and funeral meats at the uncle's supper. Most already appear as F744 to F749 and are consistent. 'Funeral meats still on the cloth' strains slightly against F545's 'a week after'. The clerk's hand correctly seeds F640. Ila's 'a cut, not a wound' is fair setup for F586 and F594. All should be listed.
